notes.title: Little Gods of the Abyss – Preparing for Full Release
notes.content: [h3]Little Gods of the Abyss – Preparing for Full Release[/h3][p]We are entering the final stage of polishing for the [b]full release[/b] of [i]Little Gods of the Abyss[/i]. After gathering player feedback and countless tests, we’ve refined the game to offer smoother controls, improved features, and an even more engaging experience.[/p][p]Players can now look forward to:[/p][list][*][p][b]More mechanics and traps[/b], bringing fresh challenges and strategies.[/p][/*][*][p]A greater variety of [b]stages[/b], providing new adventures to explore.[/p][/*][*][p]Better overall [b]playability and responsiveness[/b], making the action more immersive.[/p][/*][/list][p]The full release is not the end, but the beginning of continuous updates and improvements. We hope you’ll dive in and enjoy the expanded world of [i]Little Gods of the Abyss[/i]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38213543/b42e6f54d744190e2eb2df2a4e1f94bf7f7a1463.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Official Release Announcement – Little Gods of the Abyss
notes.content:
🎉 Official Release Announcement – Little Gods of the Abyss
Hello, this is the development team of Little Gods of the Abyss.

First of all, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has waited so patiently for Little Gods of the Abyss. Your support and patience have meant the world to us and motivated us to make the best game possible.

We are now thrilled to announce that we’ve entered the final stage of official release. After undergoing a rigorous QA process with our publisher GRAVITY, we are preparing the final touches.

We’ve worked hard to enhance the game’s depth and quality, and the upcoming official release will deliver a more polished and enriched experience.

🗓 We’ll meet you again very soon
The official release is just around the corner, and we will share the exact date shortly.
Even after the launch, we will continue to improve and expand the game with updates and feedback.

Thank you once again for your continued support.
We’ll see you again, in the Abyss.

— Little Gods of the Abyss Development Team

notes.title: Release! I am developing “DOOR” by myself
notes.content:
I am developing “DOOR” by myself. Before becoming a game developer, I wanted to be a writer, so I want to the tell the story of this game in my own words and in my own way. 

From concept design to prototype creation, it's been 2 to 3 years. While trying to find the most effective way to express the game essence, several versions were made along the way. Now we have reached the final version.

The concept of DOOR is based on the idea that "the handle that opens the door of the heart is inside." Since the game’s setting is the mind, we wanted to focus on expressing it. As a developer, I call "DOOR" an "art platformer" game because the world of the mind is represented in various ways. The gameplay is a Mario-like platformer where the player overcomes puzzles and obstacles.
